title: Nehru Park Delhi - History, Timings, Attractions & Travel Guide
content:
Nehru Park - Delhi,

Nehru Park, located in the diplomatic enclave of Chanakyapuri, is one of Delhi’s most loved green spaces. Spread over 80 acres, it is known for its serene landscapes, morning yoga sessions, and open-air concerts. The park is named after India’s first Prime Minister, Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru, and has become a hub for nature lovers, joggers, and cultural enthusiasts.

Whether you want a peaceful morning walk, a picnic with family, or to attend cultural events like Music in the Park, Nehru Park offers something for everyone.

History of Nehru Park: 

Established in 1969 by the New Delhi Municipal Council (NDMC), Nehru Park was designed to provide residents and tourists with a calm retreat from Delhi’s busy city life. Over the years, it has evolved into not just a green escape but also a cultural hotspot, hosting events like jazz festivals, art exhibitions, and yoga sessions.

Things to See and Do at Nehru Park:

  • Morning Walks & Jogging Tracks – Wide, shaded pathways perfect for fitness lovers.
  •  Cultural Events & Concerts – From Indian classical music to international jazz festivals.
  •  Art Installations – Open-air exhibitions and sculptures add to the charm.
  •  Yoga Sessions – Especially during International Yoga Day.
  •  Picnics & Relaxation – Open lawns where families and friends gather for a laid-back day.

Best Time to Visit: Nehru Park can be visited throughout the year, but the best time is October to March, when the weather is pleasant for outdoor activities. Early mornings and evenings are ideal for walks and events.

Visitor Information:

  • Location: Chanakyapuri, New Delhi
  • Timings: Open daily from 5:00 AM to 9:00 PM
  • Entry Fee: Free
  • Parking Information: Paid parking is available near the park entrance.

How to Reach:

  •  Nearest Metro Station: Lok Kalyan Marg Metro Station (Yellow Line)
  •  By Bus/Auto: Well connected by DTC buses and autos from all parts of Delhi.
  •  By Car: Easily accessible with parking facilities nearby.

Places to Visit Nearby:

  • India Gate - Just 10 minutes away.
  • Rashtrapati Bhawan- The President’s House and Mughal Gardens.
  • Lodhi Gardens - Another iconic green space nearby.

Travel Tip: Visit during early morning hours to enjoy fresh air, fewer crowds, and the calm beauty of the park.
excerpt: Nehru Park in Delhi is a peaceful and green getaway in the heart of the city. With wide lawns, cultural events, yoga sessions, and walking tracks, it is a perfect spot for relaxation and recreation.
